data.one_liner: Builds a ListView or CustomScrollView and notifies when widgets are on screen.
data.what_it_does: It provides scroll views (`InViewNotifierList` and `InViewNotifierCustomScrollView`) along with `InViewNotifierWidget` to track and notify when child widgets enter or leave a specific viewport condition area. It is commonly used for features like auto-playing videos or conditional data loading as the user scrolls.
use_when: You need to auto-play videos when they scroll into view.
You want to trigger real-time database listeners or data fetches only for visible items in a list.
avoid_when: You are using a standard ListView and do not need visibility tracking for its items.
You need complex physics or non-scroll view visibility calculations.
strengths: Supports both ListView and CustomScrollView implementations.
Configurable in-view viewport conditions and throttle duration.
Allows wrapping the internal scroll view with a pull-to-refresh or shimmer wrapper via `scrollViewWrapper`.
weaknesses: Requires unique string IDs for every child widget that needs notifications.
